name: Milton Lodge Bar and Grill
angle: Rebuild the page around the actual Lodge room: worn blue half-walls, rust-red beams, torched wood, generous food and the real antler mark.
scope: Full local rebuild from saved facts and existing images only. No new research, publication or outreach; preserve facts.json unchanged.
hours_source: facts.json; research/SOURCES.md; saved Restaurantji and Restaurant Guru pages captured September 5, 2026. Daily 7 AM opening agrees; closing times conflict with the prior Google hit-list.
hours_policy: Show seven opening-only rows in the single hours band. Highlight today, but do not infer an open/closed state. Ask visitors to call for current kitchen and closing hours.
open_evidence: Saved September 5, 2026 exact-business Google-origin reviews and owner responses support operation at capture. No October re-verification was authorized.

room_map.reason: Saved photographs show the bar and seating, but do not establish an accurate floor plan from the street, the entrance orientation or the patio connection. A map would guess geometry.

review_ribbon.reason: Saved reviews have initials rather than real profile photos and relative dates only. A five-person ribbon with verified faces cannot be built from the available local evidence.

review_policy: Link to saved review source evidence without an unsupported aggregate score, invented faces, initials-based testimonial cards, precise review dates or a simulated moving ribbon. No verified direct Google review-writing URL exists locally.

contact.google_search_note: Exact-name-and-address search only; not a verified place ID or direct review action.
contact.form_reason: No verified owner email or form delivery destination. Use the real phone and directions.

missing: REVIEW FACES: Saved Google-origin reviews in research/guru.html have only initials, relative dates and no profile-photo files. Use Variant B link-out; omit the review ribbon and record the exception.
CLOSING HOURS: Sources conflict on closes. All seven complete-hours values remain null; show seven From 7 AM rows from hours_partial, highlight today, and do not fabricate live open/closed status.
ROOM MAP: Existing room photos cannot establish street orientation, entrances, patio access or complete geometry. Omit the map rather than invent an accurate-looking plan.
DIRECT GOOGLE REVIEWS: No verified Google place ID, listing review URL or review-writing URL is stored. Exact-name-and-address search may be labeled Find on Google only.
CONTACT FORM: No verified owner email or submission destination. Omit the form rather than display a fake success interaction.
EVENTS AND SPECIALS: No confirmed current weekly event schedule or dated current special. Omit event calendar, countdown and specials claims.
EXTERIOR: Omitted under the existing-images-only scope. Later harvest-0906/g11.jpg shows a Lodge sign but is not copied or used; the old Milton Tavern exterior is not a substitute.
MENU PRICES: Saved menu has no current update date. Dish names and ingredients are used; prices and availability need owner confirmation.
OWNER STORY: Historical founder and August 2018 opening are sourced; current ownership and an owner-authored story are not verified.
BROWSER QA: Per handoffs/heroes-2026-10-22/BRIEF.md, no qa/run.sh, Playwright or browser screenshots in this run. Claude performs visual and runtime QA outside this sandbox before publication.
